pages.text: The neko world has its own $(#FF69B4)exclusive resource system$(). These materials can only be produced through the Neko Aggregator and serve as the foundation for crafting advanced items.

pages.title: Basic Resources
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Neko Ingot$() — crafted from iron ingots in the aggregator, the basic neko material$(li)$(item)Neko Diamond$() — crafted from diamonds in the aggregator, an advanced neko material$(li)$(item)Neko Crystal$() — crafted from amethyst shards in the aggregator, a special neko material$(br2)9 Neko Ingots can craft a $(item)Neko Block$(), and 9 Neko Diamonds can craft a $(item)Neko Diamond Block$() — both decorative and useful for storage.

pages.title: Energy Storage Devices
pages.text: Energy storage devices act as $(#FF69B4)portable energy packs$() — you can charge or drain neko energy in the aggregator:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Small Energy Storage$() — low crafting cost, smaller capacity$(li)$(item)Medium Energy Storage$() — medium capacity, requires small storage to upgrade$(li)$(item)Large Energy Storage$() — max capacity, requires medium storage + netherite scraps and other rare materials$(br2)Each comes in $(thing)uncharged$() and $(thing)charged$() versions. Charge empty ones or extract energy from charged ones in the aggregator.

pages.title: Use Cases
pages.text: Energy storage devices are especially handy in these scenarios:$(br2)$(li)Running low on energy during adventures? Bring a few charged devices to top up anytime$(li)Want to mass-craft but your energy cap is too low? Pre-charge a bunch of devices$(li)Store excess energy so natural regeneration never goes to waste$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Better safe than sorry — always carry a few energy packs~$()
